data.phrase:
dataset in (veeam_*) 
| filter _vendor="Veeam"
| alter 
    _instanceId=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "instanceId\=(\d+)\s"), 0)
| filter _instanceId in ("190","290","150","151","790","194","490","451","390","36022","36026","450","652","40290")
| alter 
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
        _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("36022","36026","290","40290"), regextract(_raw_log, "Result\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450"), regextract(_raw_log, "Status\=\"(\d+)\""), 
        regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),
    _host=arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log , "\s(\S+)\s(?:Veeam_MP|Veeam_Backup|Veeam_Security)"), 0)
| alter _jobResultCode=if(_instanceId in ("150","151","451","450") and _jobResultCode = "3", "1", _instanceId in ("150","151","451","450") and _jobResultCode = "5", "3", _jobResultCode)
| filter _host in ($hosts)
| alter _jobResult=if(
    _jobResultCode = "0", "Success",
    _jobResultCode = "1", "Warning",
    _jobResultCode = "2", "Failed",
    _jobResultCode = "3", "Working")
| comp
    count(_instanceId) as _jobsByResult by _jobResult 




| view graph type = pie subtype = full xaxis = _jobResult yaxis = _jobsByResult valuecolor("Success","#00D15F") valuecolor("Failed","#D10000")

dataset in (veeam_*)

| filter _instanceId in ("190","290","150","151","790","194","490","451","390","36022","36026","450","652","40290")
| alter 
    _time= parse_timestamp("%FT%H:%M:%E6S%Ez", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "<\d+>1\s+(\S+)\s"), 0)),
    _jobResultCode=arrayindex(if(
        _instanceId in ("790","652"), regextract(_raw_log, "(?:JobResult|param3)\=\"(\d+)\""),

        regextract(_raw_log, "JobResult\=\"(\d+)\"")), 0),

        _instanceId in ("290","40290"), "290", arrayindex(regextract(_raw_log, "JobType\=\"(\d+)\""), 0)),
